rna_depmap.rationale: Primary expression source; highest gene coverage (53,961 ENSG).

rna_geo.rationale: Adds samples/studies but on a different scale from DepMap.

rna_hpa.rationale: Independent RNA source useful for cross-source agreement.

protein.rationale: Enables RNA->protein confirmation (D3) despite low coverage.

fusion.blocker_or_gate: grain: emit per-partner or per-pair (design decision)

signatures.blocker_or_gate: per-column handling (binary WGD, count aneuploidy, cont. ploidy)
signatures.rationale: Genome-instability context (D11); highest coverage after mutation.

metabolomics.rationale: Per-line metabolite abundance; scale must be characterised first.

mirna.blocker_or_gate: verify_mirna_identifiers: opaque 'nmir*' IDs must map to miRBase
mirna.rationale: Optional modality; unusable until identifiers are resolvable. If mapping fails, flip to DESCOPED.

copy_number.coverage_note: ABSENT now; DepMap covers ~nearly all lines once acquired
copy_number.acquire: DepMap OmicsCNGene.csv (gene-level relative copy number); segment-level file optional. Same ACH key.
copy_number.blocker_or_gate: acquire + clean + join on model_id, then promote to IN_SCOPE
copy_number.rationale: Directly required by D5 (the CNA in 'mutation, CNA, or fusion'). Amplifications/deep deletions (e.g. ERBB2, MYC amp; CDKN2A, PTEN loss) are first-class selection signals that mutation status alone misses. HIGH impact, near-zero acquisition cost.

crispr_dependency.coverage_note: ABSENT now; DepMap CRISPR typically ~1000+ lines once acquired
crispr_dependency.acquire: DepMap CRISPRGeneEffect.csv (Chronos gene-effect scores); CRISPRGeneDependency.csv (dependency probability) optional. Same ACH key.
crispr_dependency.blocker_or_gate: acquire + clean + join on model_id, then promote to IN_SCOPE
crispr_dependency.rationale: The functional-evidence axis (functional-dependency features) and, for AZ target-selection, plausibly the single most decision-relevant signal: it answers whether a target is functionally IMPORTANT in a line, not merely expressed. HIGHEST impact of the acquisitions.

pathway_genesets.coverage_note: Not a cell-line modality; external gene-set knowledge
pathway_genesets.rationale: Needed to infer pathway activity; sourced when that feature is built.

marker_panels.coverage_note: Not a cell-line modality; curated marker lists
marker_panels.blocker_or_gate: acquire/curate marker panels at marker-feature stage (D7)
marker_panels.rationale: Receptor/marker features require curated gene panels.
